title: Card Duel Arena
description: Build a 20-card deck, duel a heuristic AI in turn-based combat, and export your strategy as a shareable code.
concept: A lightweight collectible card game: pick creatures and spells from a 24-card pool into a 20-card deck, respecting mana curve and copy limits, then duel an AI opponent across escalating mana turns. Creatures trade blows or hit face, spells burn, heal, buff, or draw — and the whole deck compresses into a shareable base64 code or link.
features: Deck builder with mana-curve chart, 24-card pool, 2-copy limit, and 20-card decks
Turn-based battle engine vs a heuristic AI (lethal detection, favorable trades, board management)
Save multiple named decks and win/loss/streak stats to localStorage
Export/import decks as compact base64 codes, or copy a shareable #deck= URL link

interaction.mouse: Click cards to play them, click your creatures to attack, click enemy hero/creatures to target spells and attacks
interaction.click: Tap pool cards to add to deck, tap hand cards to play, tap board creatures to attack
interaction.touch: Full tap support — same interactions as mouse, cards enlarge on tap for readability
